title: Affine derived sections of coefficient-sized intrinsic comparison on injectives
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, and A a commutative ring in max(v,u+1). Use the canonical constant-ring module pullback on the coefficient-sized etale and pro-etale site models of [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data]. Assume the ordinary additive sheafification instances on the two model sites and enough injectives on the pro-etale module category, so that the displayed derived evaluation is defined. For an injective etale constant-ring module I, an affine etale object W over X, and each natural number q, the (q+1)-st right derived functor of evaluation of the underlying abelian sheaf at the pro-etale image of W is zero on the comparison pullback of I. W is transported to the models by AsSmall.up and the recorded inclusion. This is local derived sections on a single affine etale object, not a higher-direct-image sheaf. No finiteness, torsion, qcqs or nonempty-scheme assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 099U, lemma-affine-vanishing, entire proof; Tag 099V, lemma-relative-comparison, first proof paragraph. The module version uses the free-module augmented Cech resolution.

proof.text: Work directly on the coefficient-sized pro-etale site, with the inverse image of proAffineEtale.overObj under AsSmall.down followed by ProEt.forget as the basis. The dense affine inclusion covers every object. Pullbacks of basis objects remain in the basis; the universal property of SiteCechComplex identifies each higher intersection with the pullback of one factor and the shorter intersection. Every basis covering admits a finite basis refinement: pull its sieve down to ProEt, use affine cover-density and finite jointly surjective refinement, then transport the arrows and their covering sieve back by AsSmall.up. These arguments do not require X itself to be affine.
The finite affine Cech calculation gives positive Cech vanishing of the intrinsic comparison pullback of I on every finite basis covering, for every choice of iterated intersections.

Identify the Grothendieck topology with that generated by its associated precoverage. Apply the second clause of the module Cech criterion in the common coefficient/site universe to the given module and its injective resolution. The resolution/right-derived isomorphism identifies its zero cohomology with the displayed derived evaluation. The transported image of W is a basis object since W is affine and etale. No restriction functor and no underlying-abelian injectivity assertion enters.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099U, Cech criterion on the affine ind-etale basis. W9: direct coefficient-sized site argument, with explicit basis and refinement transport, 2026-10-26.

theorem coefficientComparison_affineSections_vanishing (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    [HasSheafify (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v (u + 1)}]
    [HasSheafify (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v (u + 1)}]
    [EnoughInjectives (ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A))]
    (I : ConstantCompletion.Mod (ConstantCompletion.constant
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A)) [Injective I]
    (W : X.AffineEtale) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{max v (u + 1)}
      (siteModuleRings (ConstantCompletion.constant
        (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A)) ⋙
      sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{max v (u + 1)} ⋙
      (evaluation (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)ᵒᵖ
        AddCommGrpCat.{max v (u + 1)}).obj
          (op ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj
            (AsSmall.up.obj ((Scheme.AffineEtale.Spec X).obj W))))).rightDerived (q + 1)).obj
              ((constructibleComparisonPullback.{u, v} X A).obj I))
